name: Logical Reasoning
description: Deductive and inductive reasoning: syllogisms, ordering, truth-teller puzzles.

name: Verbal Reasoning
description: Language comprehension: analogies, synonyms/antonyms, passage inference.

name: Numerical Reasoning
description: Arithmetic, number series, percentages, and word problems.

name: Abstract Reasoning
description: Non-verbal rule discovery over shapes and symbol sequences.

name: Spatial Reasoning
description: Mental rotation, mirroring, and figure assembly.

name: Pattern Recognition
description: Identifying regularities in sequences, matrices, and groupings.

name: Qualitative Reasoning
description: Reasoning about relationships, causation, and categorical claims without exact numbers.

name: Quantitative Reasoning
description: Data sufficiency, ratios, rates, and quantitative comparisons.

name: Computational Thinking
description: Pseudocode tracing, algorithmic steps, and complexity intuition.

name: General Aptitude
description: Mixed general-ability items spanning several reasoning families.

name: Cognitive Ability
description: Working memory, attention to detail, and processing-speed style items.

name: Personality & Psychometrics
description: Likert-scale self-report items mapped to Big Five trait dimensions.
